{{Quote|In terms of sheer beauty, the Flandorian flower floats were a definite highlight, and the tamed herd of giant lumbering wombacks from Parada made a definite impression on the crowd.|A news report by Coruscant Daily NewsFeed|<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Parada''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sector]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the giant [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] herd creatures known as [[womback]]s. Parada [[Merchant/Legends|exported]] womback [[Leather/Legends|hides]] and [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]], as well as a variety of [[Grain/Legends|grains]], offworld, and it provided most of the food for the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]].

==Description==
Parada was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Parada system/Legends|Parada system]] of the [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sector]], a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Senex Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Rindao system/Legends|Rindao system]] as well as the [[Bortras system/Legends|Bortras system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Parada was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to [[womback]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of giant [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] herd creatures that could only be tamed if separated from their herds as newborns.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[in-universe]] news report mentioning Parada in {{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}} is set on the date 37:F1:1, which corresponds to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> a herd of tamed wombacks from Parada was presented on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="GNN" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="TEA" /> as part of the [[Shaldania Parade]], the opening ceremony of that [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]]. The womback herd from Parada was later mentioned in a [[Coruscant Daily Newsfeed/Legends|Coruscant Daily NewsFeed]] report.<ref name="GNN" />

==Inhabitants==
Womback [[Leather/Legends|hides]] and [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]] were [[Merchant/Legends|exported]] off Parada, as was a variety of [[Grain/Legends|grains]],<ref name="TEA" /> with Parada and<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> the neighboring [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector's]] agriworld [[Fengrine/Legends|Fengrine]] providing most of the food for the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] planet [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]].<ref name="SoR" /> Senex [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] were interested in the potential use of wombacks for food and sport.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parada was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]], which was published in [[November]] [[1995]]. The feature was authored by [[Paul Sudlow]].<ref name="GNN" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed the world in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[2015]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' mentioned a celestial body "Paranda,"<ref name="SoR" /> which Fry later confirmed as a misspelling of Parada's name.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
